component.name: Screend
component.summary: Capture, annotate and record your screen

description.p: Screend is a screenshot and screen-recording tool for Linux on Wayland. Press a shortcut, drag over what you want, and a small card appears: copy it, drag it into a chat, mark it up, pin it on top of your work, or pull the text out of it.

ul.li: Area, window and screen capture with a frozen-screen selector and magnifier
Annotation editor: arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps, blur, highlighter, crop
Presentable backgrounds with padding, rounded corners and shadows
Scrolling capture that stitches long pages into one image
Copy text from any part of the screen (OCR)

description.p: On GNOME a small Shell extension makes capture instant. KDE Plasma, Hyprland and Sway are supported too.

screenshot.caption: Select an area; everything else dims
Annotate with arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps and blur

description.p: First packaged release: a welcome screen that sets up shortcuts and the GNOME extension, an in-app shortcut editor, Debian packages and a one-line installer.
